purpose: Learn continuous swim, signed moving turn, and outgoing swim from physically captured states.

training.reward: 0.02 times [0.65 signed projected transport at target speed + up to 0.35 course alignment + up to 0.35 signed reduction of rolling course error during turns − squared tilt/10deg − 0.75 squared depth error/1mm]. Course terms require actual movement. Negative progress and overspeed have costs. Physical bounds stay unchanged.

starts.source: Native accepted warm swimming, preserved body, active and passive joint momentum, previous action and 2s COM history.
starts.training: 4 poses times 4 settled gait phases times both turn signs times 8 copies, 256 total, independent seeded sampling.
starts.held_out: 4 different settled starts for +15, -15, +30, -30; paired frozen baseline vs final candidate; no resets.

evaluation.scoring: Final two seconds of the turn and the outgoing two seconds must each pass speed and course. Posture, depth and clearance throughout.

stop: One attempt per stage. Stop on physics, numerical, KL or wall limit. Preserve last accepted checkpoint and exact attempt counts where observable. No retries or criterion changes.
scope: Moving-turn motor study in open pond water. No chooser, hold retraining, bank contact, autonomous runtime deployment or checkpoint replacement.
